article.title: MorningAI更新創意生成與排程標記預覽
article.title_en: MorningAI updates creative generation and scheduled mention previews
article.summary: MorningAI於11月2日公布，Studio可在一次生成中提供多個創意方向。
article.summary_en: MorningAI announced multiple creative directions per Studio generation on November 2.
highlights: 可用產品頁作參考，再調整成不同尺寸。
排程介面新增跨平台帳戶標記預覽。
highlights_en: Product-page references and resizing are supported.
Scheduling adds account-mention previews across networks.
article.why: 品牌團隊可把素材選擇與發帖前檢查連成一個流程。
article.why_en: Teams can connect creative selection with checks before posting.
article.next_step: 用一款產品核對包裝細節及標記帳戶，再決定是否採用。
article.next_step_en: Check one product’s packaging and tagged accounts before adoption.
article.detail: 這次更新涵蓋創意製作及社交排程。Studio可參考連結中的產品資料，提供不同方向，完成後再輸出其他尺寸。Calendar則顯示Instagram、LinkedIn及Facebook將連結的帳戶，方便排程前檢查。功能描述來自供應商公告；產品包裝是否準確、各方案可用範圍及實際輸出質素，仍需以帳戶內測試確認。
article.detail_en: Studio can use a linked product page and resize finished images. Calendar previews the accounts tagged on Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook. These are vendor-described features; output accuracy and account eligibility still require checking.
